text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please, make that child strong.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Not the bravado I put on for myself
just to hide my anxiety and cowardice—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Please grant that child true strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—To achieve that, victory is essential.
A victory in the GⅠ race we set as our goal, saying,
"I will definitely win this race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And to secure victory...
you need the strength built through proper training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Training for the Strongest Umamusume"
was just "fabricated confidence"
to make that training possible.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's train!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the strongest, after all!
I'm gonna do the 'strongest' training there is!"
choice_data_list: (I can't let her lose this confidence)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To draw out the true confidence sleeping within her—
a confidence that isn't just bravado.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat at the Mile CS Nambu Hai...
is surely unforgivable."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship Nambu Hai
—the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Of course the champion's gonna win! He decisively grabbed victory last time and the time before that too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, the tables will turn completely today!
Because my fave is taking the throne!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the sky gradually darkened,
the excitement in the venue surged dramatically.
This was the stage of the Gâ  Mile Championship Nambu Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hate to break it to you, but I'm the star today. Sorry!"
"Hehe... I wonder how long you'll be able to keep up that smug attitude."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the hallway before the waiting rooms,
Umamusume who had finished their preparations
were emerging one after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, among them are imposing Senior-class Umamusume.
From here on, we'll be facing off against them—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wah...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "D-Don't... sweat it. I just put too much into it, everything's totally fine...—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Wh-What's with that girl...?"
"A roar...? Scary..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her as she returned to the waiting room,
I stepped inside and closed the door.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm strong!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Strong... She's so damn strong! Strong, strong, strong!
She makes the rest of 'em look like child's play!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine... I'll win...!
I'm not... scared at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...This race is a mixed contest between the Classic and Senior divisions."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing seasoned veterans like them,
is there any Umamusume who wouldn't feel fear?
Is there any Umamusume whose legs wouldn't freeze?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And yet, even so, she—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.
choice_data_list: I've put you through some very special training.
I've put you through special training

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly pull the textbook from my bag
so she can see it too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...That.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...The training that
the 'strongest Umamusume' went through."
choice_data_list: Yeah, you've managed to see it through.
Right, you've accomplished all of that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I did the kinda training
that only strong folks do.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I did it. ...I've arrived. ...I saw it through!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All I've offered until now was a fleeting sense of security: "Just do it by the book and you'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And starting now, she will—
win a GⅠ, gaining true confidence with the results to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm strong... I'm strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Let's get this started!
The "Mile Championship Nambu Hai"!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Just you watch, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, go get that win! Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight!
I'm gonna—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm strong!!
